anomalies.description: A man (Daniel Craig as James Bond) is seen aiming and firing a handgun through a vehicle window; muzzle flash and recoil are visible in frames f9–f11, confirming active discharge.
A mounted weapon on the rear vehicle fires a visible muzzle flash and projectile toward the lead SUV.

The interior of a vehicle shows bullet impacts on the side panel (sparks and debris), consistent with a high-velocity impact during a chase; this indicates the vehicle has been struck, constituting a collision event.
The aircraft sustains a bright, localized explosion on its right wing/fuselage junction, producing a fireball and smoke, consistent with an impact or internal detonation.
